verdict.rationale: Gitea docs confirm user permission management, access control lists, and collaborator management at the repository level (gitea-docs-1, gitea-docs-7, gitea-docs-18), but there is no evidence of workspace/organization-wide or project-level granular permission structures, nor explicit branch-level protection rules being documented in this pack. missing for 10: evidence of organization/workspace-level permission scoping, project-level access controls, and branch protection rule documentation, plus independent/hands-on verification of granular permission enforcement.
